text: Claude apps: you think ten Notion edits cost you ten trips to another tab, but actually, in supported apps, you never leave the chat.
Before, Claude showed a small window: a live preview.
For the full editor, you opened Notion in another tab.
Ten tasks: back and forth, ten times.
Now, where supported, the whole Notion opens beside the chat, signed in as you.
You ask once; Claude edits all ten tasks, and you see each change as it happens.
It's built on M C P Apps, an open extension: the tool brings its own screen into Claude.
Asana, Canva, Notion and more, to start; rolling out on web and desktop, all plans, in the new Claude.
So, what we learned: ten tasks used to mean ten trips to another tab; now, in supported apps, Claude edits them beside your chat.
Subscribe, and comment what we should explain next.
